title: Divisibility, parity, primes, and coprimality
terms: divides; divisor; factor; multiple; even; odd; prime; composite; relatively prime; pairwise relatively prime; divisibility tests; square-free integer.

exposition.text:
For integers a ̸= 0 and b, a | b means b = ac for some c ∈ Z. An integer is even if divisible
by 2, and odd otherwise. A prime is an integer p > 1 whose positive divisors are 1, p; a com-
posite integer is an integer greater than 1 that is not prime. Integers are relatively prime if
their greatest common divisor is 1. Pairwise relatively prime means every distinct pair has this
property.
Divisibility by both a and b implies divisibility by ab when gcd(a, b) = 1. Digit tests follow by
reducing powers of 10: digit sums work modulo 3, 9, alternating digit sums modulo 11, and the
k k
last k digits suffice modulo 2 or 5 . The numbers 0, 1, and negative integers are not primes
under the standard definition.
An integer is square-free if no prime square divides it; the positive integer 1 is included. Eu-
clid's lemma says that a prime dividing a product divides at least one factor. Prime-exponent
parities characterize perfect squares. A gcd of one for three or more integers does not imply
pairwise coprimality, as 6, 10, 15 demonstrate.

question.text:
5
What is the greatest positive integer that divides n − n for every integer n?
(A) 10 (B) 20 (C) 30 (D) 60 (E) 120

solution.text:
The expression is divisible by 2 by parity, by 3 by checking n ≡ 0, ±1, and by 5 by Fermat.
Thus 30 always divides it. At n = 2 it equals 30, so no larger universal divisor is possible.

question.text:
An integer is divisible by 12 and by 18. Which is the largest integer that must divide it?
(A) 24 (B) 30 (C) 36 (D) 72 (E) 216

solution.text:
2 2
Divisibility requires prime powers 2 and 3 , so 36 | n. The integer 36 itself satisfies both
requirements, proving that 36 is the largest forced divisor. Multiplying 12 and 18 would
double-count shared prime factors.

question.text:
How many choices of decimal digits a, b make the four-digit integer 4a2b divisible by 72?
(A) 0 (B) 1 (C) 2 (D) 3 (E) 4

Positive integers a, b, c have greatest common divisor one, and ab, bc, ca are all perfect squares.
Which statement must hold?
(A) a = b = c = 1
(B) a, b, c are pairwise relatively prime.
(C) a, b, c are all perfect squares.
(D) Exactly one of a, b, c is even.
(E) abc is prime.

solution.text:
For any prime, the three exponents have pairwise even sums, so their parities are equal.
At least one exponent is zero because the common gcd is one; hence all three exponents
are even. This works for every prime. Pairwise coprimality is stronger and is not forced:
36, 100, 225 satisfy the hypotheses but each pair has a nontrivial gcd.
